title: October, folded blue
description: An orange ribbed pumpkin with a bent stem and a small curled leaf on folded blue cloth.
process: Original AI study in 112 animated marks, chosen in batches of one to four after 29 whole-and-close inspection boundaries. Initial framing errors were corrected before form development; a lower/right leaf pan added detail inspection. All easel notes were posted live. Broad fills closed hollow masses; a short shoulder light stayed focal. Oil covers altered the shadow more visibly than acrylic. Faceted shoulders, regular ridges and partial edge-cover corrections remain. The public broadcast ended with all 112 marks acknowledged.

title: Where the forest drinks
description: A small cascade winds through a misty forest beneath a mossy fallen log supporting a seedling.
process: 100 animated marks developed in 25 four-mark batches, each followed by whole and settled close browser inspection. Live notes and camera moves preserve bank, log, fern and light corrections. Initial framing checks repeated at marks 4 and 64. Public broadcast ended with all 100 completed marks confirmed.

title: Green wings after dusk
description: A pale green luna moth opens four marked wings and curling tails against a dusky violet ground.
process: 40 animated marks selected in batches of 1–4 after 12 whole-and-close browser inspections. Broad wing fills, layered eyespots, restrained veins and antenna corrections. Easel notes and camera moves recorded live; public broadcast ended with all 40 completed marks confirmed.

title: Red pear, blue linen
description: A red pear holds a small warm glint above folded blue linen.
process: 32 animated marks chosen in batches of 1–3 after 12 whole-and-close browser inspections. Live easel notes and camera moves preserved; broad fills, cloth corrections and a final shadow glaze. Public broadcast ended with all 32 completed marks confirmed.

title: Copper at the window
description: A small copper kettle catches a quiet window reflection against a cool ground.
process: AI-painted through 13 whole-and-close inspection boundaries, in batches of 1–3 animated marks. Broad passes filled the copper body; fuller oil made one reflection visible. Live notes and camera moves are preserved. The public broadcast ended with all 34 marks confirmed. Regular ridges and faceted edges remain.

title: What the wind leaves
description: An imagined barred owl feather rests on a cool ground, with a quiet quill light and loose base wisps.
process: Painted by an AI agent in 37 animated marks across 14 whole-and-close inspection boundaries. Broad oil filled the taper; a widened quill light broke the barring. Edge-cover corrections remained partly unsuccessful, leaving angular splits and regular ridges. Easel notes and camera moves were recorded live. Public broadcast ended with all 37 marks confirmed.

title: Lanterns on the fallen log
description: Two amber mushrooms rise from a dark mossy log in quiet forest light.
process: An AI agent painted 38 animated marks in batches of 1–4, choosing each next batch after whole and settled close screenshots at 13 inspection boundaries. Easel notes and camera moves were recorded during painting. Filled midtones corrected hollow caps; thin oil retained regular ridges. The live broadcast ended with all 38 marks confirmed. Title and provenance were added after browser export.

title: Two wings before the wind
description: Two copper-colored maple seeds rest on a quiet cool ground, their unequal papery wings opening toward the light.
process: Painted by an AI agent in 33 animated watercolor, acrylic and oil marks through 13 whole-and-close screenshot inspections. Notes and camera moves were recorded live. Broader seed midtones filled hollow forms; a single oil rib succeeded where fine acrylic was lost. Regular simulated ridges and a slightly hard contact base remain.

title: A small sea of green
description: A green anemone opens unequal curling tentacles in a quiet blue tide pool between muted rocks.
process: Painted by an AI agent in 40 animated marks across watercolor, acrylic and oil, with 13 settled whole-and-close inspection boundaries. All easel notes and camera moments were recorded live. Roots were joined, a stubborn water slit was filled, and one lip light was enlarged after review. Regular simulated oil bands remain. Broadcast ended with all 40 completed marks confirmed.

title: Small visitor, quiet morning
description: A chickadee grips a bare autumn twig, with a dark cap, pale cheek, warm breast and quiet morning air.
process: Painted by an AI agent in animated batches of 1–3 strokes chosen after 13 whole and close inspections. Notes and camera moves were recorded during painting. The public feed reached 34 marks before a local server interruption; all 37 marks and the actual finished export are preserved. Oil light accents became clearer than acrylic, but breast ridges remain regular. No engine changes.

title: Golden fans, blue glass
description: Three golden ginkgo fans rise from a small blue glass bottle on quiet linen.
process: 38 animated marks selected in batches of 1–4 through 12 whole/close inspection boundaries. Live easel notes and camera moments record filled leaf corrections, vein comparisons, restrained reflections and a final review. Metadata and journal added after export; engine unchanged.

title: Lemon at the blue hour
description: A lemon and green leaf rest on a blue saucer, surrounded by quiet linen and a soft evening shadow.
process: Painted live from a blank canvas in five batches of 3–4 animated marks, with settled whole and close screenshots between batches. Six notes were posted live; title and provenance were added after browser export. Watercolor, oil, acrylic and pencil; no engine changes.

title: Copper & pears — an oil study
description: Copper, fruit, and linen. Warm light meeting cool reflections.
process: 57 oil strokes selected in batches of 3–4 after screenshots. All 17 notes and 29 camera moments were recorded live. The oil model was corrected at stroke 18; early observations describe the original experiment, and replay uses the corrected model.

title: Where the evening goes
description: A pale sailboat finds its way through the last light of the day.
process: Painted from blank paper in eleven three-stroke batches, chosen after whole-view and close-up screenshots. All 12 teaching notes and 23 camera moments were recorded live.

title: Afternoon Flowers
description: Warm afternoon light, a blue vase, and a few bright flowers.
process: 34 strokes selected in batches of 1–3 after close and whole-view screenshots. This guided tour’s teaching notes were adapted afterward from the original session’s commentary.

title: Light returns to the harbor
description: A lighthouse, sailboat, and wildflowers around a busy harbor.
process: A 341-stroke scripted foundation followed by seven refinements chosen with close and whole-view inspections. No recorded teaching notes.

title: Where the quiet water goes
description: Where the quiet water goes. A small boat, soft water, and a little shoreline.
process: The first 75-stroke study: a 57-stroke scripted foundation, followed by 18 marks chosen after screenshot inspections. No recorded teaching notes.
